summary: Diageo plc filed a Form 6-K containing its fiscal 2026 third-quarter trading statement for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing reports organic net sales growth of 0.3% in Q3, with strong results in Europe, LAC, and Africa offset by weakness in North America and Asia Pacific. Management reiterated fiscal 2026 guidance and noted progress on the Accelerate cost-savings program. The filing also mentions previously announced divestitures of USL's RCB business and Diageo's stake in EABL, but these are not the subject of this filing—they are referenced as ongoing transactions. No new special-situation event is triggered; this is a routine quarterly earnings update.
